summary: Master the art of Protocol, Etiquette, and Event Management with our comprehensive training course. Elevate your professional presence and event planning skills
lede: Protocol training helps experienced professionals coordinate formal events through clear, controlled workflows. It covers building precedence matrices and seating plans, applying forms of address and cross-cultural etiquette, and managing VIP movements and ceremony timing. Participants also practise creating run-of-show schedules, assigning responsibilities, coordinating suppliers, and assessing event risks so teams can deliver against fixed event plans.
audienceIntro: This protocol and etiquette course is designed for experienced professionals who coordinate formal engagements, advise senior hosts, or control event delivery. It suits intermediate practitioners moving into higher-responsibility assignments and advanced professionals seeking more consistent tools.
modules: Protocol, Etiquette and Event Management Foundations
Event Management RACI and Critical Path
Run of Show and VIP Protocol
prerequisites: You should have prior experience supporting formal events, executive engagements, ceremonies, hospitality operations, public affairs, or protocol assignments. Working knowledge of spreadsheets and standard event documentation will help you complete the applied exercises. Coding or programming required: No. You should bring a laptop capable of running Microsoft Excel and accessing Microsoft Teams or equivalent approved organizational tools.
